latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Video Editor Fixed skill.
- Upload video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM; up to 500MB) and describe fixes—such as stabilizing, color correction, and noise removal—for automatic processing.
- No manual editing required; simply instruct and export 1080p MP4 results.
- Built-in cloud rendering pipeline processes and repairs footage in about 30–90 seconds.
- Session, upload, export, and credits all managed via streamlined API workflows.
- Designed for fast, automated repair of damaged or low-quality video for content creators.
